messages.content:
You answer questions for an engineering team from a memory store. The user message holds the memory you may use, then the question.
Rules:
- Answer only from the memory provided. Do not use outside knowledge and do not guess.
- If the memory does not contain the answer, reply exactly: I don't know
- When the memory does contain it, reply in one short line with just the value asked for (a name, a team, a service, a date, a note label, a reason) and nothing else.
- When a value changed over time, answer for the moment the question asks about; without a stated moment, answer for now. Today is 2026-06-30.
- Memory entries carry the date they were recorded. Treat a later entry as superseding an earlier one on the same subject.

Memory:
- Certificate expiry will alert 30 days ahead, a follow-up decision from the INC-2025-017 review. [decision; valid 2025-08-07 to now; recorded by incident-review/INC-2025-017]
- As of 2026-03-09, feature-flags is owned by the Atlas team; the 2026-02-11 handover note that said team Dune was written against the wrong team, and Dune never owned it. [decision; valid 2026-03-09 to now; recorded by handover/2026-03-09-feature-flags-correction]
- INC-2025-023 was an indexer incident on 2025-10-03 in which the indexer served stale results for two days. [valid 2025-10-07 to now; recorded by incident-review/INC-2025-023]
- The root cause of INC-2025-017 was an expired intermediate certificate. [valid 2025-08-07 to now; recorded by incident-review/INC-2025-017]
- The job scheduler leader lease will be shortened to ten seconds, a decision from the INC-2026-009 review. [decision; valid 2026-05-19 to now; recorded by incident-review/INC-2026-009]
- The indexer is pinned to OpenSearch 2.11, and the pin lifts when the full reindex completes. [constraint; valid 2025-04-22 to now; recorded by standup/cinder/2025-04-22]

- INC-2026-003 was an incident in which the webhook dispatcher delivered some events twice on 2026-02-20. [valid 2026-02-26 to now; recorded by incident-review/INC-2026-003]
- On 2025-12-31, the Atlas team saw that feature-flags' queue depth hit 50,000 following the marketing send and flagged it as not their service. [valid 2025-12-31 to now; recorded by standup/atlas/2025-12-31]
- INC-2026-009 was an incident in which the job scheduler ran the nightly jobs twice on 2026-05-16. [valid 2026-05-19 to now; recorded by incident-review/INC-2026-009]
- Tomasz was off the on-call rotation for team Dune until 2026-03-11, when he took the Dune pager; on 2026-04-14 he handed the pager to Farah. [decision; valid 2026-04-14 to now; recorded by standup/dune/2026-04-14]
    earlier: Tomasz was off the on-call rotation for team Dune until 2026-03-11, when he took the Dune pager. [decision; valid 2026-03-11 to 2026-04-14; recorded by standup/dune/2026-03-11]

- Farah was the primary on-call for team Dune until 2026-03-11, when Tomasz took over the pager; on 2026-04-14 Tomasz handed the pager back to Farah. [decision; valid 2026-04-14 to now; recorded by standup/dune/2026-04-14]
